components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Accordion, expandable card and expandable text for progressive disclosure.

components.name: ActionReview
components.summary: Concrete before-and-after review with exact target, scope and a one-time decision.

components.name: AgentControlCenter
components.summary: A run surface with visible scope, steps, pause/resume and cancellation.

components.name: AgentCursor
components.summary: A labelled cursor that shows an agent working inside the UI: moving between fields and typing, while the user watches.

components.name: AgentHandoff
components.summary: Shows work passing between agents, or from an agent to a person.

components.name: AgentLoop
components.summary: Animated plan → act → observe → reflect cycle showing which phase an agent is in.

components.name: AgentMessage
components.summary: One turn in a conversation with an agent, plus the composer, in the docked agent panel or a full chat page.

components.name: AgentOrb
components.summary: Meri, Meridian's agent character: an original slate orb crossed by the meridian arc, with eyes that show state.

components.name: AgentPlan
components.summary: The steps an agent intends to take, shown before (and while) it executes, editable by the user.

components.name: AgentRunSteps
components.summary: Shows what an agent is doing, step by step, so users can trust and interrupt it.

components.name: AgentStatus
components.summary: An inline activity label for a panel header, record or run list. Use a short action such as “Reviewing invoices” when the active operation is known. Use a small progress meter and a visible step count when the total is known.

components.name: AgentTerminal
components.summary: A streaming, terminal-style log of an agent run, for technical users who want to watch the raw steps.

components.name: AgentTimeline
components.summary: Timestamped audit events across agents, tools, approvals, and handoffs.

components.name: AICommand
components.summary: Keyboard-first actions and cited natural-language answers.

components.name: AIComposer
components.summary: Ask about the current record. Starts on one line and grows as the draft wraps.

components.name: AIEditReview
components.summary: Per-change review of proposed text or code edits.

components.name: AIWorkflow
components.summary: Node-and-edge view of an automated workflow: triggers, agents, tools, human steps.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: An inline banner for page- or section-level status that persists until resolved.

components.name: ApprovalCard
components.summary: Human-in-the-loop gate before an agent changes data, spends money or contacts anyone.

components.name: ArtifactReview
components.summary: Generated artifact handoff keeps version, source and review state visible.

components.name: AuditExplorer
components.summary: Chronological audit events distinguish human, agent and system actors.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A person's initials (or photo) in a circle. Agents use AgentAvatar instead.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: One to three words of status for a record; the tone carries meaning, never decoration.

components.name: Banner
components.summary: Full-width announcement, agent-activity and trial banners, plus the cookie consent panel.

components.name: BarChart
components.summary: Charts live in a Card and draw series with `chart-1…6` in order. This preview shows a stacked bar; the rules cover all chart types.

components.name: BlueprintHero
components.title: Blueprint hero
components.summary: Centered product positioning over a technical drafting illustration.

components.name: BriefComposer
components.summary: Write a brief. Starts with 3 rows for tasks that need a longer prompt.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Triggers an action. Secondary is the default; **primary** appears at most once per view.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: Button group, split button, copy button and hold-to-confirm: compound buttons built from Button.

components.name: CanvasComposer
components.summary: Start a new draft. Starts with 5 rows for tasks that need a longer prompt.

components.name: Card
components.summary: The container for one unit of content on a page: a chart, a list, a form section.

components.name: CardStack
components.summary: A stack of record cards reviewed one at a time: swipe or press → to move on.

components.name: ChatThread
components.summary: Grouped conversation turns with attachments and citations.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Checkbox, Radio and Switch: the three choice controls, sharing one style.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: Code block, JSON viewer and code suggestion (diff with accept/reject).

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: Searchable select (combobox) and multi-select, for long or dynamic option lists.

components.name: CommandComposer
components.summary: Run a quick command. Starts on one line and grows as the draft wraps.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.summary: Keyboard-first launcher for navigation, actions and agent questions (⌘K). Also the home of the "AI command" pattern.

components.name: ConnectorSetup
components.summary: Connecting a data source or tool for agents: scopes, credentials and a test.

components.name: ConsultationDialog
components.title: Consultation dialog
components.summary: A focused modal lead form with keyboard-safe dismissal.

components.name: ContextComposer
components.summary: Reply in a thread. Starts on one line and grows as the draft wraps.

components.name: ContextWindow
components.summary: How much of the model's context an agent session is using, by category; includes prompt cache stats.

components.name: ContourParallax
components.title: Contour parallax
components.summary: A topographic plate with native viewport-linked drift.

components.name: ConversionPanel
components.summary: A focused closing call to action with supporting trust copy.

components.name: Cover
components.summary: Meridian visual composition.

components.name: DashboardShowcase
components.summary: A full agent-driven dashboard composed only from Meridian components, following the Dashboard page pattern: app shell, PageHeader, KPI row, insight and approval, then a "Needs attention" table. Resize to see the sidebar collapse to a rail (under 1024px) and hide (under 768px).

components.name: DataFlow
components.summary: A live system diagram: data moving between sources, warehouse, agents and destinations, with health on each node.

components.name: DataGrid
components.summary: Editable, spreadsheet-like grid with cell focus, inline editing and conditional formatting.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: Search, filter, sort, select and act on records. The workhorse of business apps.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: Calendar, date picker, date range picker with presets, time picker and color picker.

components.name: DateReel
components.summary: A wheel-style date and time picker with snap scrolling, for touch-first scheduling.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal that interrupts for a decision or a short task. Drawers (right side, 480px) use the same anatomy for longer forms.

components.name: Dock
components.summary: A floating launcher whose icons magnify toward the pointer, for apps with a handful of top-level areas.

components.name: DonutChart
components.summary: Donut (part of whole, ≤4 parts), gauge (one value against a target) and waffle charts.

components.name: DownloadGate
components.title: Download handoff
components.summary: A direct download with clear file format and no lead capture.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Side drawer for forms and detail previews; becomes a bottom sheet on phones.

components.name: EditorialAction
components.title: Editorial action
components.summary: A high contrast closing section with two explicit routes.

components.name: EditorialHeader
components.title: Editorial header
components.summary: An understated editorial header with a native flyout.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: What a list, table or dashboard shows before it has data: an invitation, not an apology.

components.name: EnrichColumn
components.summary: An agent fills a new column for every row (enrichment, classification, smart form fill).

components.name: EvaluationScorecard
components.summary: Evaluation scorecard separates quality, reliability and budget regression.

components.name: EvidencePanel
components.summary: Source provenance, quoted excerpts and explicit limits on generated findings.

components.name: FieldworkEditorialHero
components.title: Fieldwork editorial hero
components.summary: Large serif typography, generous space and an original topographic plate.

components.name: FileDropzone
components.summary: Drag-and-drop upload area with a file list showing progress and results. Avatar upload is the same pattern in a 64px circle.

components.name: FilterChips
components.summary: Chip group (multi-select toggles) and Rating.

components.name: FilterToolbar
components.summary: Filter toolbar (applied filters as removable chips) and reorderable list.

components.name: FrostedPanel
components.summary: A translucent, blurred layer that floats over live content, keeping context visible behind it.

components.name: FullscreenIndex
components.title: Fullscreen index
components.summary: A large format index with a modal reading order.

components.name: FunnelChart
components.summary: Funnel for stage conversion. Sankey, radar and streamgraph follow the same card and token rules.

components.name: GenerationReveal
components.summary: Agent-generated content (charts, images, documents) resolving from a field of tiles as it finishes.

components.name: Heatmap
components.summary: Activity heatmap (calendar grid) and treemap for density and hierarchy.

components.name: IllustratedColophon
components.title: Illustrated colophon
components.summary: An illustrated footer with a warm clay terrace plate.

components.name: ImageCompare
components.summary: Before/after slider, for comparing an original with what an agent produced.

components.name: ImageGeneration
components.summary: Prompt and variation workspace for generated images.

components.name: InlineEdit
components.summary: Click-to-edit text for titles and single fields on detail pages.

components.name: InsightCard
components.summary: An agent-generated finding on a dashboard: a headline, the evidence, and how sure it is.

components.name: IntegrationCatalog
components.summary: Connector cards expose availability, scopes and sync state.

components.name: InvoiceWorkbench
components.summary: Searchable invoice table with status filtering, amount sorting and CSV export.

components.name: Keycaps
components.summary: Tactile keyboard keys for teaching shortcuts, with a pressed state that reacts to the real keyboard.

components.name: LaunchMegamenu
components.title: Launch megamenu
components.summary: Two grouped link columns and a release announcement.

components.name: LineChart
components.summary: Line and area charts for trends over time; brush chart adds a range selector under the main plot.

components.name: LivePill
components.summary: A compact, always-visible island that grows to show what an agent is doing in the background, then shrinks back.

components.name: LLMCostEstimator
components.summary: Workload-based model spend estimates with dated pricing assumptions.

components.name: LocaleShowcase
components.summary: The same invoice header, KPI and table row in five markets, showing that Meridian components adapt to language, script, direction and number formats without any component changes.

components.name: MeetingSummary
components.summary: Source-linked meeting notes with decisions and follow-up actions.

components.name: MegaNavigation
components.summary: Responsive product navigation with a native disclosure and a categorized flyout.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: A list of actions that opens from a button, usually the "⋯" row or page overflow.

components.name: ModelCard
components.summary: A model's identity, capabilities and live stats; covers provider status, generation stats and provider keys.

components.name: ModelRouting
components.summary: Task-oriented model routing makes cost and fallback policies inspectable.

components.name: MorphButton
components.summary: A button that shows its own result: idle → working → done, or a two-step inline confirm for small destructive actions.

components.name: NewsletterEdition
components.title: Newsletter edition
components.summary: A publication signup with native validation and visible feedback.

components.name: NotificationInbox
components.summary: Action-oriented notification inbox links directly to the relevant review surface.

components.name: NumberInput
components.summary: Number, money, phone and percent inputs: one input group with prefixes, suffixes and steppers.

components.name: OrbitalProductHero
components.title: Orbital product hero
components.summary: A cinematic blue-black hero with original orbital linework and a clear product action.

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: The top of every page: where you are, what this is, what you can do.

components.name: PasswordField
components.summary: Password input with show/hide and a strength meter.

components.name: PathwayFooter
components.title: Pathway footer
components.summary: Three clearly framed destinations for readers who reach the end of a page.

components.name: PermissionMatrix
components.summary: Readable role-permission matrix for administration and security reviews.

components.name: PiiRedaction
components.summary: Shows which personal data was masked before text reached a model.

components.name: PinnedChapters
components.title: Pinned chapters
components.summary: A sticky chapter heading beside a naturally scrolling narrative.

components.name: PipelineBoard
components.summary: Keyboard-operable task board with explicit move controls.

components.name: PlanDecisionCTA
components.title: Plan decision
components.summary: Plan selection with monthly and annual price examples.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: Popover, hover card and confirm popover: small floating panels anchored to a trigger.

components.name: PricingComparison
components.summary: Three-tier pricing with a functioning billing-period switch.

components.name: ProductHero
components.summary: Split editorial hero with an original orbital illustration and clear navigation.

components.name: ProductProofCTA
components.title: Product proof action
components.summary: A conversion section with the actual review interface alongside it.

components.name: ProductProofHero
components.title: Product proof hero
components.summary: A split hero that demonstrates a real review state in the headline area.

components.name: ProductSubnav
components.title: Product subnavigation
components.summary: Breadcrumbs and secondary navigation for a product family.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Progress bars for measurable work, skeletons for loading content, spinners only inside buttons.

components.name: ProgressivePanels
components.title: Progressive panels
components.summary: Editorial feature panels with a restrained entrance effect.

components.name: ProgressRings
components.summary: Concentric goal rings: two to three related goals at a glance.

components.name: QuietFooter
components.title: Quiet footer
components.summary: A slim sign-off for documentation and product tools.

components.name: RadialMenu
components.summary: Quick actions that fan out in a circle around a floating button.

components.name: RadioCards
components.summary: Radio options presented as cards, for choices that need a description.

components.name: ReasoningBlock
components.summary: Collapsible summary of how the agent reached its answer.

components.name: ReplyDraft
components.summary: Agent-drafted text the user edits before using; covers ghost-text completion, tone, translate and TL;DR toggles.

components.name: ResearchComposer
components.summary: Research a question. Starts with 3 rows for tasks that need a longer prompt.

components.name: ResizablePanels
components.summary: Split view with a draggable divider; Scroll area for contained scrolling.

components.name: ResourceFooter
components.summary: Multi-column resource footer with identity, documentation and product links.

components.name: ResourceMatrixFooter
components.title: Resource matrix footer
components.summary: A compact footer grid for products with extensive documentation.

components.name: ResourceRail
components.title: Resource rail
components.summary: A narrow sidebar index with breadcrumbs for structured documentation.

components.name: ResourceSearchNav
components.title: Resource search navigation
components.summary: A searchable resource index inside a navigation disclosure.

components.name: ResponseFeedback
components.summary: Feedback and utility actions under an agent answer, with generation stats.

components.name: RichTextEditor
components.summary: Rich text editor with a formatting toolbar and agent writing actions, plus a signature pad.

components.name: RollingNumber
components.summary: A number whose digits roll like an odometer when it changes.

components.name: RunBudget
components.summary: Explicit cost, tool-call and time limits for agent runs.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: Search input with icon, shortcut hint and clear button. Expanding search collapses to an icon button in tight toolbars.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: A compact single-choice switch for 2–5 options that change a view immediately.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Choose one value from a list of 3–15 options.

components.name: ShareAccess
components.summary: Sharing panel: invite people, set roles, see who (and which agents) have access.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: The app's primary navigation, fixed on the left.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: Slider for one value, and a range slider with a histogram showing how data is distributed.

components.name: SlidingTabs
components.summary: Segmented control and tabs whose selection indicator glides to the chosen item.

components.name: SnapPlateGallery
components.title: Snap plate gallery
components.summary: A manual horizontal gallery with snap points and explicit controls.

components.name: SourceCards
components.summary: The sources behind an agent answer as numbered cards, matching the inline citation chips.

components.name: Sparkline
components.summary: Sparkline (tiny trend, no axes), split bar and animated counter, for use inside StatCards and table cells.

components.name: SpotlightCard
components.summary: Interactive card with a soft light that follows the pointer along its border.

components.name: StarterPrompts
components.summary: Starter prompts and the "ask your data" entry point: an input plus suggested questions grounded in the user's data.

components.name: StatCard
components.summary: A single KPI: label, value, and what changed against a stated period.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: Horizontal steps for multi-step flows (wizards, onboarding, imports).

components.name: StickyProductNav
components.title: Sticky product navigation
components.summary: A persistent product header with reading progress.

components.name: SubscriptionUsage
components.summary: Quota and subscription usage with units, reset date and accessible meters.

components.name: SuccessMoment
components.summary: A brief, restrained celebration for meaningful completions: a check that draws itself, two ripples and a ring of sparks.

components.name: TableOfContents
components.summary: On-page navigation for long reports and docs, highlighting the section in view.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switch between views of ONE record or dataset, under the PageHeader.

components.name: TagInput
components.summary: Tag input (multiple values as chips) and mention input (@people, @agents, #records inside text).

components.name: TeamSwitcher
components.summary: Workspace / team / client switcher for the top of the sidebar.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: A labelled single-line input or multi-line textarea, with helper or error text.

components.name: TextReveal
components.summary: Streaming agent text where each word settles in from a soft blur, so streaming feels calm instead of jittery.

components.name: ThemeSwitcher
components.summary: Light / System / Dark switch, a Segmented control bound to `data-theme`.

components.name: Timeline
components.summary: Activity timeline and comment thread, the audit trail of people and agents on a record.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Brief confirmation of something the user just did, bottom-right, auto-dismissing.

components.name: ToolCall
components.summary: One tool call an agent made: what it did in plain words, the tool, arguments, result and timing.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short label that appears on hover or focus, mainly for icon-only buttons and truncated text.

components.name: TrainingRun
components.summary: Training-job progress, metrics, checkpoints, and controls.

components.name: TreeView
components.summary: Tree view and tree table for hierarchical data.

components.name: TypeFirstHero
components.title: Type-first hero
components.summary: A masthead-sized wordmark and one action on a rust color field.

components.name: UsageMeter
components.summary: Usage meters (quota against a limit), onboarding checklist and countdown.

components.name: VectorSearch
components.summary: A visual of semantic search: the question as a point, documents as dots, and lines drawn to the nearest matches.

components.name: VoiceInput
components.summary: Voice orb for dictation/voice mode and a speech player for spoken agent output and meeting summaries.

components.name: WordmarkColophon
components.title: Wordmark colophon
components.summary: An oversize serif sign-off with a practical link index.

components.name: WorkspaceOnboarding
components.summary: A four-step checklist with native controls and live progress.
